name: prompt-897
image_purpose: High-end beauty and knitwear lookbook reference showing product texture, portrait detail, and poised fashion poses.

prompt.project_info: Create a polished 2x2 beauty fashion editorial grid with one consistent approved adult fictional woman, warm off-white studio, and a taupe fuzzy knit dress.
prompt.main_subject: One adult fictional woman with long loosely wavy voluminous hair, dewy realistic skin, warm natural makeup, and glossy natural pink lips, wearing a fitted taupe fuzzy knit mini dress with tasteful coverage.
composition_elements: Panel 1: extreme close-up beauty crop with the subject holding a fresh strawberry near her lips; keep the moment food-focused and non-sexualized.
Panel 2: thigh-up fashion portrait leaning slightly toward the lens with a poised editorial pout and knit texture clearly visible.
Panel 3: seated curled-up editorial pose with cheek resting near the knee and a dreamy gaze; maintain tasteful coverage and natural anatomy.
Panel 4: close beauty portrait with chin resting on interlaced fingers and a soft smile.
Keep the same face, hair, dress, makeup, and warm color grade in every panel.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Large diffuse softbox from front-left with gentle reflector fill from the right, warm off-white and beige seamless studio, soft tactile highlights, luxurious calm beauty mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-photorealistic high-end editorial photography, detailed skin, hair, strawberry, hands, and boucle knit texture, realistic anatomy, consistent identity, clean 2x2 grid, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-photorealistic 2x2 high-end beauty fashion editorial grid, one consistent adult fictional woman with long loosely wavy voluminous hair, dewy realistic skin, natural pink glossy lips, wearing a fitted taupe fuzzy knit mini dress with tasteful coverage, panel 1 close-up holding a strawberry near her lips in a food-focused moment, panel 2 thigh-up poised fashion portrait leaning slightly toward camera, panel 3 seated curled-up dreamy editorial pose, panel 4 beauty portrait with chin on interlaced fingers and soft smile, warm off-white seamless studio, large diffuse softbox front-left and reflector right, tactile knit detail, consistent styling, no text, no watermark.
